reviews.text:
My go-to boarding kennel for the past three years 🩷
I have complete trust in Jeanne, Wassim, and the entire team, who always do their utmost for their little guests...and to reassure their adoptive parents ☺️.
It's become an indispensable place for me when I'm away, where I always leave with complete peace of mind.

Thank you, Le Berlioz! 🥰

A huge thank you to Jeanne and the entire team for taking such wonderful care of our two cats, Sparky and Mochi, for three weeks! It was the first time we'd left them for so long, but Jeanne's attentiveness and kindness completely reassured us. She was incredibly caring and attentive to their every need. Our cats never lacked human company and received countless cuddles. The stay went wonderfully, and we picked up our cats happy and content. We wholeheartedly recommend the Hotel Berlioz and will definitely be back! Thank you all so much!

We left our cat Chipie at the Hôtel Berlioz for four nights and we were delighted with our experience!

The entire team took excellent care of her. They were lovely, very kind and attentive, and kept us updated on her very regularly. Chipie felt very comfortable there, which allowed us to enjoy our stay with complete peace of mind.

The facilities for cats are truly wonderful. The spaces are designed with their well-being in mind, and the animals are clearly the center of attention. It's so nice to see establishments evolving in this direction.

And a very welcome little touch at the end of our stay: we left with some small gifts for Chipie, including treats and toys. 🥰

I highly recommend the Hôtel Berlioz if you're looking for a safe, caring, and high-quality place to board your pet while you're away. A truly wonderful experience!

We entrusted our two cats to Berlioz for the first time this summer for a four-week stay. Everything went wonderfully; we received regular updates, the place is very well designed, the welcome was very friendly, and it's clear the cats feel right at home. A big thank you to the whole team, and we look forward to our next stay! :)

The Hotel Berlioz is a welcoming and warm, high-end place for cats.

My two cats, Gandalf and Salem, say they were delighted with their stays, during which the staff took excellent care of them in every way.

Gandalf particularly emphasized how much he enjoyed making new friends, while Salem was a bit more reserved about that.

Personally, I'm always reassured to entrust my eighth wonder of the world to the Hotel Berlioz team because I know my cats will be safe and pampered, and also because I regularly receive updates, photos, and videos during their stay.

It's worth noting that a stay at the Berlioz is a significant expense. However, I feel that the value for money is excellent.

Angelo had a wonderful time during my vacation and he'll gladly come back 😻
Thanks again for the beautiful photos 🤩 …

I had to leave my cat Pino for the first time in three years; I didn't trust anyone… so I chose Berlioz, and it was an excellent experience. Jeanne and her team are very professional and gentle with cats, while also being reassuring to their owners.
A second stay that was just as wonderful. Our little cat, who demands a lot of attention, received plenty of cuddles. Thank you for your excellent care.

Absolutely sublime!
My cat spent 4 days and 3 nights at the Hotel Berlioz with Wassim, his wife, and the other cats. I received excellent care and was kept informed daily about her well-being. My cat was well looked after, comfortable, and, above all, very safe.
Throughout her stay, Wassim was attentive and understanding.
It's a truly exceptional hotel. It's a really good option when you need someone to look after your cat rather than leaving them alone at home, even if a cat sitter comes during the day! At least at the hotel, there's almost always someone on hand, and any problem will be reported.
I recommend it 100%! A thousand thanks again; you're simply a fantastic team!

Finding someone to look after your cat when you have to be away is always a little stressful. But from the first contact with Jeanne and Wassim, you immediately understand that you're dealing with true enthusiasts. Not just enthusiasts who love cats: enthusiasts who understand them.

The private space is spacious, well-maintained, very clean, and designed down to the smallest detail with cats in mind. During the day, the cats can explore the communal area with its toys, structures, attractions, and plenty of little nooks to feel safe… or socialize with the other guests. It's not just a cat boarding facility: it's a luxury staycation!
Everything is seamless, professional, incredibly clear, and transparent: from check-in to check-out, including the Berlioz App which centralizes all the information. Not to mention the videos and updates that Jeanne sends you during your cat's stay. A huge thank you to the whole team, and see you very soon!

Troca & Aude
